key_insight: Giving a language model read-only SQL access to structured perovskite device data raised quantitative question-answering accuracy to about 51%, versus 16–23% with passage retrieval.
engineering_relevance: Literature-scale comparisons of solar-cell measurements benefit from validated device tables and executable queries, not text retrieval alone.
method: Compute 755 ground-truth answers directly from measured device records.
Benchmark six retrieval architectures with an open 14B model on one 24 GB GPU.
Compare passage retrieval with read-only SQL access for quantitative queries.
evidence_signal: Evaluation used 45,441 device records and 158,274 passages from 25,662 papers; SQL-enabled accuracy reached 51.5% on historical and 50.8% on prospective literature.
watch_item: Accuracy remains near 51%, and deployment depends on reliable extraction and maintenance of structured device data.
paper_title: Benchmark for Structured Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Perovskite Photovoltaics
